article:
# Rules vs a decision model

The rules reached [91.2%](run:1#accuracy) on [500](run:1#n) labelled posts, with a median
latency of [12.4 ms](run:1#latency_ms.p50). A 2026 study found [3.5%](https://arxiv.example.org/abs/2604) of research
links were invented. Labelling took me [about 4 hours](obs:labelling-log).

Models: `qwen3:8b` on an `RTX 4060` with `Python 3.12`. The run started 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z,
gpt-oss-120b judged it, the library was version 1.2.3, the change is PR #41, see the note[^1].

1. A first step with no figures.
2. A second step.

<!-- backed-by: run:1 -->
| model | accuracy |
|---|---|
| rules | 0.912 |

```
for i in range(100): total += 3.5
```

## Results from 2 runs

<!-- a comment with 99 numbers in it -->

https://arxiv.example.org/abs/2604.body: We found that 3.5% of links were invented and 10.1% did not open.
